admission.justification: The gate is in mcp/src/agents_remember/canvas/presenter_tools.py and the sentence in mcp/src/agents_remember/canvas/explainer_browser.py, and the prospective and server suites prove that the first call fetches nothing and that the serving path answers the announce.

applicability: The first render of a leaf whose installation has no Playwright module or Chromium yet.
conditions: The workspace has not yet been given the sentence for this missing browser.
The render is called again after the sentence has been said.
exclusions: A render on an installation whose browser is already present, which goes straight to publication.
A second call after the announcement, which fetches.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_explainer_server.py — the wired announce, RED with ToolError 'run' before the repair; the walk on the fourth installation: announcement at 17:10:11, no renders folder, no browser folder

statement: The first render on an installation whose browser is missing fetches nothing: it answers state "announce" with the missing part and one sentence, and only the next call fetches and publishes, so nothing is downloaded before the user could be told.
